name: github.com/openshift-online/rh-trex-ai/components/api-server
reason: HyperShell requires RegisterPrefixedRoutes to mount ADLC extension kinds under /api/hypershell/ext (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#62), plus gRPC transport security fix (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#54), JWT issuer and audience validation (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#52), and fail-closed signed-token verification (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#53). compensatingVerification: The dependency is commit-pinned; API server formatting, vet, golangci-lint, unit tests, and integration tests run against that exact commit.
